title: mvrx.2: Fix Nucleo puck Kconfig — add missing CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP
description: Nucleo puck build required ad hoc audit override for CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP before reaching the radio-link failure. Add the missing Kconfig to the puck board's prj.conf or defconfig so it builds canonically without overrides.
close_reason: Resolved. CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP=y was already present in nucleo_wl55jc.conf (landed in 35660e6bd1, July 19); the Nucleo puck build was red for two OTHER reasons, both fixed here: (1) coap_server.c msg_inbox_post contained a stale 'oscore.is_protected/oscore.ctx/oscore.piv_len' reference left over from the shared-authorize-helper migration (74fa456a45) — under CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE=y this does not compile; migrated to is_protected/oscore_ctx/piv_len and fixed the coap_oscore_protect_response call args; (2) msg_inbox needs the keys store + SLIP, absent on this board — added CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS=y + CONFIG_LICHEN_SLIP_TRANSPORT=y, plus RAM trims to fit the 64KB SRAM (heap 2048->1024, net pkt/buf 2/2/4/4, NET_BUF_FIXED_DATA_SIZE, COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE 640 = the BUILD_ASSERT floor 512+128, LOG_MODE_MINIMAL, STACK_SENTINEL=n since MPU_STACK_GUARD is unavailable on this SoC and CANARIES=y remains the guard). Verification: full west build -b nucleo_wl55jc of lichen/apps/puck green (zephyr.elf linked, no RAM overflow) with CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP=y confirmed in .config. Kconfig-loop caveat: the earlier WIFI-loop failures during iteration were from a mid-edit conf (ZTEST_STACK_SIZE on non-test SoCs, STACK_SENTINEL forced off by MPU deps) — final conf is warning-clean.
